_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live squad state. Read by squad_state.py. TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md is the human narrative. Update BOTH after every actioned transfer. LEDGER NOTE, 7 Sep 2026 (GW4 transfer): O.Dango was recorded here at £6.5m but sold LIVE at £6.4m - a real price fall, so the £0.1m is a genuine loss of team value, not a bookkeeping error. squad_value+bank therefore moves 100.1 -> 100.0. THREE unrealised drifts remain and are deliberately NOT reconciled into this ledger (per the weekly-brief runbook: flag drift, never silently absorb it): VERIFIED AGAINST THE LIVE SITE 7 Sep 2026 - Mbeumo £8.0m->£7.9m, Thiago £8.0m->£7.9m, Shaw £4.5m->£4.4m. The live site reports Squad value £98.4m against this file's £98.7m, and those three account for the full £0.3m. DO NOT treat that £0.3m as spendable, and do not reconcile it into squad_value here - the ledger is bought_for-based by design. The live BANK matched this file exactly at £1.3m, so nothing in the GW4 transfer was mispriced. Root cause is roadmap B1 (price forecasting), gate GW3, still not built - now overdue. Previous correction 2 Sep 2026 (Sarr/João Pedro) preserved in TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md.
as_at_note: ACTIONED LIVE, confirmed 7 Sep 2026, via Claude-in-Chrome browser automation. GW4 pre-deadline (Sat 12 Sep 2026 12:30 UTC). TRANSFER RECORDED, 7 Sep 2026, Sylvan's own call on the brief's Option 2: O'Reilly + O.Dango OUT, Szoboszlai + Van de Ven IN. Both banked free transfers used, 0 pts cost, bank £0.4m -> £1.3m. Also clears the 3-Brentford-attacker soft breach the optimiser has flagged since GW3. CAPTAIN CHANGED: B.Fernandes -> João Pedro (captaincy_odds, shrunk + intel, neutral: E[pts] 5.50 vs Gabriel 5.42 vs B.Fernandes 5.21 - Bruno drops because United host City in GW4). VICE CHANGED: Thiago -> Gabriel. NOTE the ceiling/floor trade-off, taken knowingly: João Pedro's P(blank) is 48.8% against Gabriel's 26.3%; Gabriel was the floor alternative and was not taken. EVIDENCE BASIS: on the standing ROLE_INTEL fence alone this move is worth only +0.14 xP/90 - the case rests on two Trello news bites NOT yet in the fence, priced as a scenario_squad.py run: O'Reilly's back strain (6 Sep evening sweep, first sourced timeline - mild ~2wks, severe up to 4wks, both running past this deadline; injury_report still lags at DOUBTFUL 75%) modelled at stp 0.10, and O.Dango's started/dropped/started-then-hooked-at-HT pattern modelled at stp 0.65 (my sizing, the card proposes none). With those priced in: +3.33 xP/90, +16.6 pts over a 5-GW hold. THAT FIGURE IS A CONDITIONAL UPPER BOUND, NOT A FORECAST - xP_adj is blind to start rate, so stp acts only as the 75% XI gate; both players simply fall out of the XI and the gain decays toward +0.14 if the news is wrong (roadmap A0.5). LIVE SUBMISSION VERIFIED: Confirm Transfers panel read 'O'Reilly -> Van de Ven 0 pts, O.Dango -> Szoboszlai 0 pts, Total cost 0 pts, active for Gameweek 4'; after a FRESH RELOAD the site shows 15/15, Gameweek transfers 2, In the bank £1.3m, and zoomed badges confirm Joao Pedro C / Gabriel V. NOTE the armband save FAILED SILENTLY on the first attempt - the checkboxes showed the new badges on the pitch but a hard reload had reverted them to B.Fernandes C / Thiago V; it took a second pass plus the 'Save Your Team' button and the 'Your team has been saved.' banner to persist. This is the third time that bug has bitten - the reload check in FPL_LIVE_TRANSFER_STEPS.md is what caught it, again. PREVIOUS (GW3): no transfer, captain B.Fernandes - preserved in TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md.
